connector.registryDescription: AI-powered bookkeeping and tax filing for entrepreneurs at the heart of the European economy.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.norman.finance over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package norman-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace finance.norman. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
